items: 2 cups chicken stock, unsalted, preferably homemade
1 teaspoon kosher salt, or half the amount of table salt
1 stalk lemongrass, bottom half only, smashed and cut into 2-inch pieces
5 makrut lime leaves, roughly torn into big chunks, center stems removed
3–4 Thai chilies, bruised or cut into large pieces
1 teaspoon finely chopped palm sugar, or granulated sugar
1 small onion, cut into medium pieces
Chopped green onion and/or cilantro, for garnish

steps.title: Simmer the chicken
steps.body: Bring **1 teaspoon kosher salt** and **2 cups chicken stock** to a boil, then add **1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs** and simmer for 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.body: Add **1½ cups coconut milk**, **12 thin slices galangal root**, **5 makrut lime leaves**, **1 stalk lemongrass**, half of the fish sauce, **1 small onion**, **2 carrots** and **1 teaspoon finely chopped palm sugar** (or granulated sugar). Simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add the mushrooms
steps.body: Add **5.5 oz oyster mushrooms** and simmer for 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Season with lime
steps.body: Add fish sauce as needed, then turn off heat and add **2½ tablespoons lime juice**. Taste, and add more as needed.

steps.title: Remove the aromatics
steps.body: Remove galangal root, lime leaves and lemongrass.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve as a side dish or with rice as a main dish.
